description: This file defines the 'ScreenSlidePageFragment' class, which is an Android Fragment used in a sample app to represent a single page in a screen slide or wizard flow. It includes methods to create instances with a specific page number, initialize the page number from arguments, inflate the fragment layout, and retrieve the page number.

classes.name: ScreenSlidePageFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a page with a page number, used in a view pager or slideshow.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the fragment with a specific page number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the page number from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and sets the page number text.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Returns the page number represented by this fragment.
